title: Uncertainty intervals
outcome: Explain uncertainty intervals using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Read a supplied uncertainty interval. A fictional study supplies an interval for a mean time difference under its stated sampling model.
given: Estimated difference B−A is -0.8 seconds; supplied 95% confidence interval is [-1.4,-0.2] seconds. Assume the study’s interval method is appropriate.

steps.label: Interpret the sign
steps.detail: Negative B−A means B took less time under this measurement convention.

steps.label: Respect coverage meaning
steps.detail: 95% describes the method’s long-run coverage, not a 95% probability for this fixed parameter.

explanation: An uncertainty interval conveys precision under assumptions. Its endpoints, units, comparison direction and method all matter; the interval is supplied here, not calculated from unavailable raw data.

counterfactual.prediction: It includes zero and positive differences, so both no difference and slower B remain compatible with that interval.
counterfactual.reason: The new upper endpoint crosses zero.

student_task: Locate -0.8 and zero relative to the supplied interval [-1.4,-0.2]. Interpret the sign and confidence-method meaning, then describe what changes with interval [-1.4,0.3].
teacher_answer: -0.8 lies between the interval endpoints. Negative B−A means B took less time under this measurement convention. 95% describes the method’s long-run coverage, not a 95% probability for this fixed parameter. Changed case: It includes zero and positive differences, so both no difference and slower B remain compatible with that interval. The new upper endpoint crosses zero.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: An interval does not establish practical value or causality, and invalid sampling assumptions can invalidate its interpretation.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
